title: PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 10 - View A
doubts: Annotations in views A, B, C are drawn in isometric planes (about 30 degrees); boxes are the axis-aligned box enclosing the rotated text or frame, so boxes of stacked items overlap.
Frames and depth lines stacked under an nX callout carry that callout's multiplier (same convention as the d2mi hand keys).
D8 is followed by a flag note symbol 4 (FN4, pointing to note 4); the flag is excluded from the D8 text and box, note 4 itself is keyed.

Note 4 (flag note, applies to the holes marked with flag 4) imposes a requirement, keyed as a note; its boxed number is inside the box. Note 5 is the general profile note, keyed with the frame inline (official T37).
STR2 ALL SURFACES INSIDE POCKET keyed as its own note item (qualifier that sets the extent of T16); FSI counts 17 surfaces but no count is printed, multiplier 1.
Excluded: notes 1, 2, 3 (CAD model, precedence, applicable standards incl. movable datum targets) and note 6 (UNITS: MILLIMETERS); DF1-DF3, CS1.

items.text: 4. FULL DIAMETER OF EACH INDICATED HOLE MUST INTERSECT WITH THE CROSS-DRILLED HOLE AT ITS BOTTOM. INDICATED HOLES MUST NOT CONTACT FAR SIDE OF CROSS- DRILLED HOLES.
